name: live-ov
description: Live OV-kaart en reisplanner voor Nederland

scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend run gtfs:update
scripts.start: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green --kill-others "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend start"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit
